stem: Which of the following correctly defines 1 joule of work?
options: 1 newton force moving it 1 m along the force
1 newton force applied on an object for 1 second
1 kilogram mass moving through a distance of 1 m
1 newton force per metre of displacement produced
explanation: Correct option: (A). 1 J = 1 N x 1 m: work of 1 joule is done when a force of 1 N displaces an object by 1 m in the direction of the force. Force multiplied by time is not work, mass times distance is not a force times displacement, and force divided by distance has the wrong unit.
